Radio Group

Radio Group wraps multiple radio buttons into a labeled, accessible group with horizontal or vertical layout options.

Vertical Radio Group

Default vertical layout with descriptions.

Choose a notification method
Get notified via email.
Get notified via text message.
Get notified via push notification.
HTML
<fieldset class="zak-fieldset">
  <legend class="zak-form-label">Choose a notification method</legend>
  <div class="zak-radio-group">
    <div class="zak-form-check">
      <input type="radio" name="notif" id="email" class="zak-form-check-input zak-radio" value="email" checked>
      <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="email">Email</label>
      <span class="zak-form-text">Get notified via email.</span>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-form-check">
      <input type="radio" name="notif" id="sms" class="zak-form-check-input zak-radio" value="sms">
      <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="sms">SMS</label>
      <span class="zak-form-text">Get notified via text message.</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</fieldset>

Horizontal Radio Group

Display radio options horizontally.

Select orientation
HTML
<fieldset class="zak-fieldset">
  <legend class="zak-form-label">Select orientation</legend>
  <div class="zak-radio-group-horizontal">
    <div class="zak-form-check">
      <input type="radio" name="orient" id="left" class="zak-form-check-input zak-radio" value="left" checked>
      <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="left">Left</label>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-form-check">
      <input type="radio" name="orient" id="center" class="zak-form-check-input zak-radio" value="center">
      <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="center">Center</label>
    </div>
    <div class="zak-form-check">
      <input type="radio" name="orient" id="right" class="zak-form-check-input zak-radio" value="right">
      <label class="zak-form-check-label" for="right">Right</label>
    </div>
  </div>
</fieldset>

With Descriptions

Each option includes a description for clarity.

Select your plan
HTML
<div class="zak-radio-group">
  <label class="zak-radio-card">
    <input type="radio" name="plan" value="free" checked>
    <span class="zak-radio-card-check" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    <div class="zak-radio-card-content">
      <strong>Free</strong>
      <span class="zak-form-text">$0/month — 1 user, 1GB storage</span>
    </div>
  </label>
  <label class="zak-radio-card">
    <input type="radio" name="plan" value="pro">
    <span class="zak-radio-card-check" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    <div class="zak-radio-card-content">
      <strong>Pro</strong>
      <span class="zak-form-text">$19/month — 10 users, 50GB storage</span>
    </div>
  </label>
</div>

Validation

Show validation state on radio groups.

Select a category
You must select a category to continue.
HTML
<fieldset class="zak-fieldset zak-fieldset-danger">
  <legend class="zak-form-label">Select a category</legend>
  <div class="zak-radio-group">
    <div class="zak-form-check">
      <input type="radio" name="cat" class="zak-form-check-input zak-radio">
      <label class="zak-form-check-label">Option 1</label>
    </div>
  </div>
  <span class="zak-form-text zak-text-danger">Please select a category.</span>
</fieldset>

CSS Classes Reference

ClassDescription
.zak-radio-groupVertical radio group
.zak-radio-group-horizontalHorizontal radio group
.zak-fieldsetFieldset wrapper with border
.zak-fieldset-dangerError state fieldset
.zak-radio-cardCard-style radio option

Accessibility

  • Use <fieldset> and <legend> to group and label radio groups.
  • All radios in a group share the same name attribute.
  • Use role="radiogroup" on custom containers if not using native fieldset.
  • Arrow keys should navigate between options within a group.
  • Include descriptions using aria-describedby for complex options.
